subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT an example of inertia at rest?

options.text: Falling down of dust particle while dusting a cloth
Falling down backward when a vehicle starts immediately
The detachment of leaves/fruits due to shaking
The sudden application of brakes in a vehicle

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Option 4** is NOT an example of inertia at rest. It refers to the sudden application of brakes in a vehicle, which is an example of inertia of motion, not inertia at rest.
 
• **Inertia at rest** is the tendency of an object to remain at rest unless acted upon by an external force.
